parameters.content:
Env (required)
- N8N_REALM (default: default)
- GITLAB_API_BASE_URL (or GITLAB_BASE_URL)
- N8N_GITLAB_TOKEN (or GITLAB_TOKEN)
- HR_TALENT_GITLAB_PROJECT_ID or HR_TALENT_GITLAB_PROJECT_PATH

Request body (required)
- person_key
- skill_id
- level

Request body (optional)
- realm
- evidence
- notes
- requested_by


Env (optional)
- ZULIP_API_BASE_URL
- ZULIP_BOT_EMAIL
- ZULIP_BOT_API_KEY
- HR_TALENT_ZULIP_STREAM
- HR_TALENT_ZULIP_TOPIC
